0.0: Please, take this medal. It's reserved for the bravest Sakura Castle warriors. Don't mind the stain. No matter how much I scolded at it, the medal simply wouldn't polish itself.

no.0: There's no need to be humble. I never am.

yes.0: Sakura Castle will remember your name for generations to come! Actually, did you ever tell me your name?
